about: Upcoming deep dives. The scheduled task takes the first entry with status 'planned' whose 'not_before' date has come, makes it, then marks it 'posted'. Add new entries at the end; keep at least 6 planned. 'why' is the topical hook to use in the title or first card when it is still true on the day.

Needs a reachable 1991-2020 source (e.g. Stefano pastes the Cuneo Levaldigi WMO CSV or ARPA Piemonte table into the repo). 2026-11-02: Tuscany worked through the regional LaMMA 1991-2020 pages; look for the same kind of regional climatology page for Piedmont. 2026-11-08: made. No sunshine: Sun layer swapped for Soil (atlas bedrock + Study lesson Tortonian/Helvetian). Truffle fair (10 Oct to 6 Dec 2026, visitlmr.it) not used on screen. Station marker label sits high in the top UI zone; place shot map labels close to the chips.
